os_adapter_differences: Firmware-native resource calls replace Linux regulator, clock and interconnect APIs
UEFI bring-up polls status and keeps interrupts masked until a runtime handler owns them
UEFI assigns a bus-1 CFG0 window after link-up; DMA remains disabled until the XNU SMMU owner is ready
Shared-resource ownership checks, bounded failures and restoration protect the rest of the UEFI boot
The fixed 168-byte v5 handoff and local proprietary firmware embedding are retained
